title: Been playing my own game for hours, but I think seeing someone else enjoy it would feel even better.
author: Procastimoyk
selftext:
I made this game and somehow keep getting distracted playing it while I’m supposed to be testing 😂

It’s called Brick Breaker Infinite, inspired by Ultra Pool and Bricks Breaker RPG. Here’s me trying to get first place. Would love to have someone give me a score to chase!

Build your ball army, experiment with forging to create overpowered combos and hybrids, arrange their order, and find the best angle to clear the board.

I made this and still haven’t managed to clear an arena myself 😅 If you clear one, I wanna see!

It’s free to play, no login required. Try it in your free time and play your hearts out. If you beat my record, send me a screenshot 🙂

Send it to a friend and see who gets further. Suggestions and feedback are welcome too!

[Play Brick Breaker Infinite](https://brickbreakerinfinite.world/)

comments.author: AgitatedUse4032
comments.body:
It was entertaining for some minutes, then I found out all my progress gets deleted after they reach bottom. The name made me think it was infinite, I don't want to restart a game from 0 and waste time.

The ball Ai are bad too, they all go together and keep losing 90% of them doing no damage since they follow each other. 

Goal 10 is extremely difficult it starts with 2 boxes that need 14 hits each and two turns away to lose since they are almost at the end.

replies.author: Procastimoyk
replies.body:
Thanks for giving it a try! Starting over after losing is intentional, but I get that “Infinite” gave you a different expectation.

The balls follow the same shot angle, so finding an angle that keeps them hitting bricks is part of the challenge. Your build matters too: changing the ball order, upgrading damage, and combining balls into hybrids can make a big difference. The idea is to experiment with different setups when one isn’t working.

That said, I’ll check the goal 10 situation you mentioned. I want it to be challenging while still giving you a fair chance. Appreciate the detailed feedback!

replies.author: Procastimoyk
replies.body:
Also forgot to mention, you can upgrade both normal and hybrid balls to boost their damage and effects. As the game scales, adding more level 1 balls won’t always be enough.

For me, part of the fun is starting a new run with what you learned, trying a different build, and coming back stronger with better combinations and upgrade choices 🙂

replies.author: Procastimoyk
replies.body: But question do you think adding a paddle would make it better?

comments.author: Kalaminator
comments.body: Cool, this is like Arkanoid but boring

replies.author: Procastimoyk
replies.body: Haha, fair if it didn’t click for you 😅 The part I enjoy is experimenting with hybrids, upgrades, and ball order alongside finding the right angle. What felt boring to you: the pace, the shots, or the build choices?

replies.author: Procastimoyk
replies.body: Adding a paddle would make it better right?
